lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Wim Hof in the morning freeze
Misogi under waterfall
Spartan eating less by choice
Russian banya — cold recall

Not the cold that finds you

The discipline of discomfort
Builds the unbreakable base

Chosen not imposed

From comfortable to composed

[OUTRO]
Choose the cold.
Before the cold chooses you.
